[SWS_ComM_00889] ⌈In sub-state COMM_FULL_COM_NETWORK_REQUESTED and
configuration
parameter
ComMNmVariant=LIGHT|NONE
([ECUC_ComM_00568])
and
timer
for
ComMTMinFullComModeDuration([ECUC_ComM_00557])
has
expired
and
no
user
request
ComM_RequestComMode(<user>,
COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION)
and
the
DCM
does
not
indicate
ComM_DCM_ActiveDiagnostic(<channel>)([SWS_ComM_00873]), the ComM chan-
nel state machine shall switch to sub-state COMM_FULL_COM_READY_SLEEP.⌋
Rationale for [SWS_ComM_00889]:
As long as timer for ComMTMinFullComModeDuration has not expired the sub-state
shall be kept, to prevent toggling.
